Inline comment at .github/workflows/triage.yml:9 (right side of the diff)
${{ github.event.issue.title }} (issue title) is expanded into this run script before it runs, so whoever opens or
edits the issue can inject code; issues runs with the repository's secrets and token. In `jobs.label`.
**Fix:** Pass the value through env: (for example env: TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}) and use it quoted in
the script ("$TITLE"), so it stays data instead of becoming shell code.
